criteria.statement: /settings/profile route exists and is reachable from UserMenu Edit Profile.
Profile fields are locally validated before signing or publishing.
Valid profile submissions create kind-0 metadata events signed through the active auth signer flow.
Publishing verifies per-relay OK outcomes and requires at least one accepted relay.
Relay rejection and connection failure behavior is deterministic and does not update the cached profile.
Settings exposes the Profile surface, and user-facing docs describe profile publishing behavior.
